editions.briefing: President Trump called his Asia trip a success despite few concrete results, and a second judge moved to block his planned arch. The White House fired its national cyber director after tech outages. The S&P 500 fell 3.7% in an AI stock sell-off, entering a correction. An Anthropic mathematician claimed a Riemann hypothesis proof, still unverified. In Idaho, lawmakers plan a bill to regulate e-motos.

The US and Iran traded strikes across the Gulf, with drones reported near bases in Kuwait and Bahrain. Mary Peltola won Alaska's Senate race, and Xi greeted Trump at the APEC summit. OpenAI released GPT-6.2, and Anthropic's IPO is reportedly set to price this week. HHS finalized a HIPAA records rule, and the US lost measles elimination status. In Idaho, a Fish and Game commissioner will plead guilty in a poaching case.
